findings.problem: The voice says dividing by a fraction is times its flip and the twenty-sixes cancel, but the board jumps from (26/9)/(−26/3) straight to −1/3, so the student never sees the flip or the cancelling.
findings.fix: Before the answer line, write = \dfrac{26}{9}\times\left(-\dfrac{3}{26}\right) on "times its flip", then write the boxed −1/3 on "The answer is".

findings.problem: The board scrolls up for the Add power note, hiding the title, then scrolls back down at beat 7. It does the same again at beat 10 and beat 11, so the screen shifts up and down.
findings.fix: Keep the board fixed through beats 6–10, or scroll only forward so the eye moves down and never jumps back.
